title: Random Manhunt
description: This is not normal Manhunt. This is suitable even if you dont know how to beat the game.
body:
# **Random Manhunt** 
Random Manhunt is an Plugin that randomizes the Hunter every 5 Minutes (by default, you can change all times in the config.yml). The Hunters goal is to kill everyone. For every kill the Hunter does he gets one point. The runners can get points if they survive the 5 minutes. If you manage to beat the game (you can increase the default 30 Minutes per game to higher values) everyone who's a runner at the point will get 2 points, that spices the game up, by the hunter wanting to kill the runners even more.  If the Hunter kills everyone, or 5 Minutes are over, the next random hunter gets assigned. If you die to the Hunter, you get to keep your inventory and the hunter cannot kill you or track you in the next 2 minutes (also configurable). If you die naturally you will lose your stuff. Same for the Hunters. Easy Rules, beating the game is not required, and easy to use. By default the hunter will have an Actionbar to see the position of the nearest player. If your more skilled, or dont like it that way, you can change to compass mode in the config. If playing with multiple Hunters, they are not able to hurt each other, and if a hunter does a kill, all other Hunters will get half a point instead of a full point. Note: It is enabled by default that the game ends after the ender dragon dies. If you dont want that, change that in the config.yml.

Commands:
- starthunt <numberofHunters> » Starts the Random Manhunt Game with how many hunter you want.
- endhunt » Ends the Current Hunt if one is active.



You can use this plugin for Youtube Videos or Streams, but then you must give credits.
Suggestions can be submitted in the Discord Server. Issues can be submitted in the discord or the github repo.
